meta.name: TDH Crypto Futures Strategy Evidence Atlas
meta.scope: Evidence-backed and bot-implemented strategy hypotheses for liquid/high-cap crypto futures/perpetual research.
important: Evidence score is research confidence, NOT expected return or probability of profit.
A strategy family may be supported while an exact parameter combination remains unvalidated.
Spot-paper evidence is explicitly penalized when transferred to futures/perpetuals.
Bot/repository existence is implementation evidence only, not profitability evidence.
No live or paper trading is implied; this artifact is designed for backtest/research prioritization.
meta.coverage_note: This is a high-coverage evidence atlas, not a claim to have enumerated every webpage or paper on the internet. Systematic reviews are used as coverage backstops, then high-load-bearing primary studies and reproducible implementations are prioritized.

research_principles: Prioritize structural carry/basis and replicated trend families before indicator soup.
Separate alpha signal, sizing, exit, execution and risk-overlay hypotheses.
For high-cap futures, require net edge after taker/maker fees, funding, spread and conservative slippage.
Prefer parameter plateaus to single-point optima.
Apply White/SPA-style reality checks or FDR/other multiple-hypothesis controls across large sweeps.
Use purged chronological splits; do not randomly shuffle time series.
For microstructure strategies, backtest at the granularity needed to model queue/spread/latency; candle backtests are insufficient.
For carry, model collateral, funding timestamps, basis legging, borrow/custody and liquidation risk.
For pairs, re-test cointegration stability and hedge-ratio drift; never assume correlation implies mean reversion.
Treat martingale/grid averaging as negative controls unless hard inventory/liquidation limits prove otherwise.

families.name: Fixed-maturity cash-and-carry basis
families.thesis: Long spot / short rich futures when annualized basis exceeds all-in hurdle.

families.name: Delta-neutral perpetual funding carry
families.thesis: Long spot / short perp when expected funding received exceeds basis, fees and financing.

families.name: Donchian/channel breakout + volatility targeting
families.thesis: Break recent channel extremes; size inversely to volatility; exit on shorter channel/trailing stop.

families.name: Own-return time-series momentum
families.thesis: Long when own past return positive, short when negative; volatility-scale exposure.

families.name: Funding-adjusted perpetual fair-value deviation
families.thesis: Trade deviations from funding-adjusted no-arbitrage price/bounds.

families.name: Filter-rule breakout
families.thesis: Enter after x% move beyond recent extrema, optionally requiring persistence.

families.name: Cross-sectional futures basis factor
families.thesis: Rank contracts by basis; exploit the empirically strong basis premium.

families.name: Basis term-structure / roll-down
families.thesis: Exploit relative richness across maturities while controlling delta.

families.name: Moving-average trend ensemble
families.thesis: Price/fast MA above slow MA by threshold with persistence; reverse symmetrically.

families.name: Volume-weighted time-series momentum
families.thesis: Weight market trend information by volume before forming TSMOM signal.

families.name: Dynamic cointegration + OU half-life pairs
families.thesis: Select cointegrated pair, estimate hedge ratio and mean-reversion half-life, trade spread z-score.

families.name: 6h adaptive trend + rolling asset selection
families.thesis: 6h trend signals + volatility trailing stop + rolling Sharpe/market-cap selection.

families.name: Volatility regime gate / target-vol overlay
families.evidence_level: broad momentum evidence + crypto tail-risk studies
families.thesis: Scale exposure by inverse realized volatility and cap leverage in high-vol regimes.

families.name: High-liquidity daily momentum
families.thesis: Use prior-day/short-window direction primarily in liquid/high-cap contracts.

families.name: Multi-horizon price-volume trend factor
families.thesis: Aggregate trend/volume information across horizons and rank assets.

families.name: Liquidation/leverage stress gate
families.thesis: Reduce/disable exposure as liquidation and leverage stress rises.

families.name: Intraday BTC time-series momentum
families.thesis: Use early high-volume session return to forecast later high-volume session.

families.name: Order-flow imbalance top-of-book taker alpha
families.thesis: Trade only when OFI + spread/VWAP state predicts short-horizon direction; prefer taker when edge exceeds fees.

families.name: Volatility-managed momentum
families.thesis: Scale momentum exposure down as realized volatility rises.

families.name: Cross-venue perp price/funding spread
families.thesis: Delta-neutral long cheap venue / short rich venue or harvest funding spread.

families.name: Copula mispricing on cointegrated pairs
families.thesis: Condition on cointegration then use copula tail/mispricing index for entries.

families.name: Quarter-hour opening order imbalance
families.thesis: Measure imbalance at quarter-hour opening; forecast 4–12h returns.

families.name: Kalman dynamic hedge-ratio spread
families.thesis: Dynamic hedge ratio via state-space model; z-score residual spread.

families.name: Support/resistance breakout
families.evidence_level: large-scale technical-rule evidence but weaker cost results
families.thesis: Break rolling highest/lowest close by x%, with persistence.

families.name: Funding-aware perpetual market making
families.thesis: Tilt reservation price/inventory target using expected funding.

families.name: State-dependent L2 liquidity + trade-flow
families.thesis: Classify liquidity state first; condition directional flow signal on state.

families.name: VWAP-to-mid microstructure deviation
families.thesis: Use signed VWAP-to-mid deviation jointly with OFI/spread rather than alone.

families.name: Bollinger volatility breakout
families.thesis: Trade close outside volatility envelope in trend regime.
main_failure_modes: not directly established in futures literature

families.name: Avellaneda-Stoikov-style inventory market making
families.evidence_level: strong theory, crypto implementation; alpha depends on infra
families.thesis: Quote around reservation price with inventory-aware spread.

families.name: OI/volume-confirmed breakout
families.evidence_level: microstructure/futures rationale; limited direct strategy proof
families.thesis: Require breakout to be accompanied by OI/volume expansion.

families.name: Cointegration pair + DRL execution overlay
families.thesis: Keep statistical pair selection deterministic; let DRL govern execution inside hard risk shield.

families.name: Turn-of-the-candle 15m clock anomaly
families.thesis: Exploit abnormal return concentration around 15m boundaries.

families.name: Trend-strength regime gate
families.thesis: Allow breakout/trend only above trend-strength threshold; allow mean reversion below.

families.name: Extreme funding contrarian overlay
families.thesis: Treat extreme crowded funding as a contrarian condition, not standalone entry.

families.name: Generic cross-sectional momentum
families.thesis: Rank winners/losers; long top / short bottom.

families.name: MACD trend confirmation
families.thesis: Use MACD only as confirmation for stronger trend/breakout signal.

families.name: ATR/Supertrend-style trailing trend
families.thesis: ATR-derived trailing regime line; use as exit/overlay rather than standalone alpha.

families.name: RSI reversal with range/regime gate
families.evidence_level: large technical-rule study but mixed OOS + negative reality-check
families.thesis: Fade RSI extremes only when trend strength is low and spread/cost permits.

families.name: Bollinger mean reversion with ADX gate
families.evidence_level: common bot pattern; limited robust proof
families.thesis: Fade outer band toward mean only in low-trend regimes.

families.name: Single-asset rolling z-score mean reversion
families.evidence_level: generic, not strongly proven for high-cap futures
families.thesis: Fade normalized deviation from rolling mean only under explicit stationary/range filter.

families.name: Generic short-term reversal
families.thesis: Fade recent extreme move only in regimes where liquidity evidence supports reversal.

families.name: Single-venue triangular arbitrage
families.thesis: Trade temporary cross-rate inconsistency if executable edge exceeds all costs.

families.name: Pure maker MM without toxicity filter
families.thesis: Baseline only; deliberately included as negative control.

families.name: Symmetric grid mean reversion
families.thesis: Place laddered contrarian entries and close on small bounce.

families.name: Martingale-inspired futures DCA
families.evidence_level: implementation evidence only; severe tail risk
families.thesis: Average into losing positions to improve entry; included only as risk/negative-control family.

channel_breakout.channel_width_c_note: Paper HTML lists {0.05,0.01,0.5,0.1,0.25,0.5}; duplicate 0.5 appears in source, so do not silently infer a missing value.
